scenes.line1: How do LLMs automate real tasks?
scenes.say: Ever wondered how language models do more than just generate text? What lets them automate real-world tasks?

scenes.label: Tools
scenes.sub: LLMs can call APIs or functions to fetch data or run calculations.
scenes.say: Tool calling means a language model can reach out to APIs or functions, grabbing data or running calculations beyond just words.
Agents use language models to plan, call tools, parse responses, and summarize results. Each step builds on the last for complex tasks.
Designing agents with clear tool descriptions and validating outputs keeps them reliable. Without this, you risk unsafe actions.

scenes.question: What’s a common agent mistake?
scenes.right: Always sandbox actions and monitor outputs to prevent unintended or unsafe behavior.
scenes.say: A big interview trap? Letting agents run unchecked. Always sandbox their actions and monitor outputs to stay safe.
